mission: Make the remaining-50 follow-up readable over REST: the apply (run 38977099606) wrote 50 Yuyu identity-capture work items, but their ids exist only in the blob-stored artifact, and db-diagnostic summaries carry row counts only, so a cloud session cannot record the work ids or check capture progress and denials. The enqueue summary now lists written_work_ids, db-diagnostic summaries carry rows within the annotation budget, and a new read-only diagnostic identity-capture-work lists each identity-capture item's state, denials and transient failures. Staging only; no collector, setting, price, identity, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no deploy, enqueue or write runbook run in this PR.

impacts.reason: Summary fields only: db-diagnostic adds rows/rows_omitted (statements in file order within 18,000 characters, after the existing secret scan of the output), enqueue-remaining-50 adds written_work_ids. Queries, read-only session, guards, approval gate and the apply's expected_sha256 check are unchanged.
New SELECT-only diagnostic over freshness_work/freshness_attempts for scope yuyu-identity:%, run in the existing default_transaction_read_only session.
Adds identity-capture-work to the diagnostic choice list (the test keeps it equal to scripts/diagnostics). No permission, secret, environment or trigger change.
Asserts small results inline, oversized ones are named in rows_omitted, and the annotation stays one chunk.
Documents the new summary fields and the diagnostic.

resources.name: GitHub Actions: ops-readonly db-diagnostic summary and ops-write enqueue-remaining-50 summary (scripts/ops)

impact.deployment_impact: Ops tooling, one read-only diagnostic, a workflow choice entry, test and docs. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/ or apps/ changes.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR restores count-only summaries and removes the diagnostic. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: A summary that carries a secret value (the run.py scan would delete the outputs) or an ops-readonly run that fails on the new diagnostic.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: ops-readonly db-diagnostic identity-capture-work returns the 50 work items written by run 38977099606 in its ops-summary rows.
